_comment: Source-quality contract, profile based and topic independent.
A profile never decides whether a claim is true. It decides which sources may enter
the record at all (rejection) and how high a claim resting only on a given tier may
be graded (tier_status_ceiling). Editing this file is expected; it is user data.
allow_source_types      null = any; otherwise a whitelist, everything else rejected
deny_source_types       blacklist, applied after the whitelist
allow_domain_suffixes   host suffixes that are always admitted by this profile
deny_domain_suffixes    host suffixes rejected by this profile
max_authority_tier      integer; sources with a numerically higher tier are rejected
tier_status_ceiling     {tier: max status} applied in verify to the best tier

open.label: open
open.description: Nothing is rejected. Quality is expressed as tier labelling, and a claim resting only on tier-5 anecdote cannot rise above qualified.

strict-academic.label: strict-academic
strict-academic.description: Peer-reviewed, primary, official and standards material only. Forums, blogs, wikis, social posts and vendor marketing are rejected at ingest.

practitioner.label: practitioner
practitioner.description: Strict-academic plus signed practitioner material: conference talks, engineering write-ups, technical blogs with a named author. Anonymous forum posts still rejected.

sentiment.label: sentiment
sentiment.description: Forum, review and comment material is the primary artifact, not a fallback. Nothing is rejected and the tier ceiling is lifted, because tier-5 text is exactly what is being measured.
